purpose: Watermark for stopping-review cycles. A review processes EVERY route whose counter is > last_reviewed_route_counter, regardless of when or by which agent its logs were synced locally. Do NOT anchor a review on 'whatever was just downloaded' -- another agent may sync routes for unrelated reasons, and the routes you need may already be local or only on the device. After completing a review, set last_reviewed_route_counter to the highest route processed and append a review_log entry. Routes <= the cursor are considered done and are not re-reviewed.
procedure: 2. Enumerate routes on BOTH the device (/data/media/0/realdata) and locally (~/.route_sync/data/media/0/realdata) with counter > cursor.
3. Sync any missing ones logs-only (tools/route_sync/refresh_routes.py --include-rlog; never video).
4. Analyze the union; for V2 stopping reviews, key on engaged longControlState==stopping runs (not just v<0.1, which catches manual/disengaged stops).
5. Update last_reviewed_route_counter to the highest counter processed; append a review_log entry; commit.

review_log.finding: Bookmark review: the cruise fault RECURRED (user: 'that part didn't work') after the prior StopReq-on-override fix (c06b9ea4db). Root cause re-diagnosed and PROVEN: longitudinal_planner.py:899 forced output_should_stop=True for force-coast+standstill -> holds via the SCC managed stop (StopReq) -> with NO lead the car's TCS treats it as invalid and disables ACC (accFaulted) the instant the driver gas-overrides. Corpus proof: 25 gas-resume-from-stop events -> 2/2 no-lead force-coast resumes FAULTED, 0/23 lead-backed resumes clean. distanceToStopTarget=-1 at both faults (should_stop was force-coast-forced, not MPC). The prior frame-fix could not help: the fault is the car reacting to BEING in a no-lead managed stop (override at t=51.5 -> ACC disabled -> accFaulted t=52.3, StopReq already 0). FIX (db889cd638, deployed): apply_force_coast_standstill_hold() only forces the managed stop when an actionable lead (<8m) backs it; no-lead -> hold via firm openpilot brake (-1.0, no should_stop -> no StopReq) so the resume is a plain override the SCC accepts. Also lifts force-coast's firm braking off the gentle no-lead stop (user's 2nd point: 'could be smoother, no lead'). 4 new CI regression tests; logic verified standalone + ruff/compile. User accepted on-road verification of hold firmness (firm-hold IS the StopReq we removed). 0000175a: NO engaged stops (0 stopping frames), force-coast only at highway speed (segs6-7, 18-37 m/s coast), 0 accFaulted -> clean, nothing to tune. ON-ROAD WATCH: (1) no-lead force-coast stop holds without creep, esp. on a slope; (2) cruise fault GONE on gas-resume from a force-coast stop; tune FORCE_COAST_NO_LEAD_HOLD_ACCEL from feel.

Bookmark review (user-reported pair, route 00001756 seg12). TWO force-coast bugs found + FIXED + deployed (commits 500252db4b, c06b9ea4db; device c06b9ea4). NOTE: deployed code is byte-identical V2 runtime to when these were driven, so the bugs were live. BUG 1 (harsh no-lead stop): a 12.3 m slow lead (0.28 m/s closing) appeared while v~0.05 + force-coast engaged -> planner aTarget spiked to -1.70 because should_allow_force_coast_stronger_lead_brake had `if output_should_stop: return True` blanket-bypassing the kinematic gate; command jerk-limited up while the car crept to 0.34 m/s, then IMU -1.44 slam; lead vanished. FIX: dropped the bypass (longitudinal_planner.py) -> distant-slow/no-lead falls back to the gentle force-coast cap, close/closing leads keep full authority (P1-safe). BUG 2 (accFaulted on resume): gas tip-in out of the StopReq-latched standstill hold shipped SCC12 with StopReq=1 + ACCMode=2/positive aReq -> Hyundai SCC faulted. FIX: release the StopReq latch on cruiseControl.override (hyundai carcontroller.py), inert otherwise. Tests: hyundai fork CAN 25 passed (2 new); planner logic verified standalone + 4 new regression tests (run on CI; msgq uncompiled locally). ON-ROAD WATCH: force-coast slow/phantom-lead creep stays gentle; force-coast CLOSE lead (<6m) STILL brakes firm; gas tip-in from hold = clean pull-away no accFault.
